title: Ron's visits to the spirit world with Elby; the crystal table

tellings.quote: here? Anyway, Elby takes him to the spirit world three times.

plain: A man from Utah known only as Ron says a being called Elby took him to the spirit world three times, and his account includes a crystal table. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron passes this on from what Ron told him. If true, it would be a firsthand account of a guide taking a living person to a world beyond death.
